title: On divergences in a four-derivative scalar field theory
normalization_reading: At epsilon=0, the coefficient multiplying (partial sigma)^2 in the bare perfect-square operator is g_PS=4*pi*lambda_MS at leading matching order. Therefore beta_gPS=-(5/(16*pi^2))*g_PS^3-(15/(128*pi^4))*g_PS^5+... .
source_statements: The perfect-square trajectory is preserved under renormalization.
The beta function is asymptotically free and is related to O(2) phi^4 at negative coupling.
The Ward identity ties coupling and field renormalization.
Off-shell Euclidean correlators are perturbatively infrared finite at fixed nonzero external momenta.
transcription_boundary: This record transcribes the continuum dimensional-regularization/minimal-subtraction normalization needed for the lattice score comparison. It does not prove a lattice-to-MS matching theorem, an all-order lattice score estimate, a nonperturbative Gibbs bound, or a continuum limit.
